assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production asset for an interactive personal portfolio world map. Image 1 is the APPROVED PALETTE, MATERIAL, LIGHTING and PAINTERLY STYLE reference. Image 2 is a REFERENCE FOR MONUMENTAL SCALE, deep floating cliffs and distinct landmark architecture ONLY; do not copy its UI, labels, characters, entire composition or saturated glossy rendering. Create ONE isolated floating island, transparent alpha background, square canvas, full island entirely visible within about 6 percent margin, elevated front three-quarter view matching Image 1, upper-left sunlight, softly shadowed lower-right. Keep Image 1's warm ivory limestone, grass/sage/olive foliage, sky-blue water, cool teal rock shadows, matte painted broad color planes and controlled detail. Monumental human-scale architecture, readable silhouette at 250px, structural logic, large cliff faces, no tiny decorative noise. Terrain and buildings are a static cutout; animated water will be composited separately. Include shallow visible water basins and obvious stone spillway lips at the front cliff but NO long flowing waterfalls or mist baked into the image. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, UI, sign boards, logos, watermark, people, sky, ground plane, far islands, glow, crystals, gold decoration, excessive microtexture, plastic shine or photorealism. This is one island asset, not a full world map or contact sheet. The largest landmark, PROJECTS exhibition citadel: a majestic broad multi-level ivory stone exhibition palace with a tall central arched entrance, two unequal square towers, deep arcaded gallery wings, broad grand staircase and a sunlit upper garden. Muted sage tile roofs, restrained architecture, large convincing arch spans rather than a dense forest of fantasy spires. Entire architecture occupies upper half with a strong tall central silhouette. The island is a huge rugged roughly shield-shaped limestone mass with deep vertical strata and an arch-like opening near its lower-left, clearly more massive than a small lawn. A large turquoise reflecting pool occupies the front terrace, with THREE clearly visible broad spillway notches across the front edge, centered around 34%, 52% and 73% of canvas width at about 59% canvas height, for separate animated curtain waterfalls. Dry hanging cliff below; keep water at the lips only. Long ragged rock base ends around 88% canvas height. Trees frame architecture rather than hide it.
